presentation.label: DigiSwarm
presentation.summary: An effects engine for the Digitone's inputs: eleven engines with four variations each, a 60-second looper, a resonant filter and a reverb, in time with the tempo.
presentation.overview: DigiSwarm, by irpina, is an effects engine for the Digitone mk1's two audio inputs: eleven engines with four variations each, a 60-second looper, Hold, Reverse, a resonant filter, pitch modulation and a reverb with four rooms, all in time with the Digitone's tempo.
highlights: Eleven engines with four variations each, picked from the trig keys.
A 60-second looper with record, overdub, undo and reverse.
A resonant filter, pitch modulation and a reverb with four rooms.
usage: Hold a track key, pick DIGISWARM in the Mod Menu and press YES.
Play into the inputs and pick an engine with trig keys 1-11, a variation with 13-16.
Turn ACT and MIX on page 1 (SYN1); on page 3 push LOOP to record a loop.
Press NO to turn DigiSwarm off and get the synths back.

access.location: Mod Menu: hold a track key
steps: Use a build containing DigiSwarm for the Digitone mk1 on OS 1.43 or 1.44; fxkit comes with it.
Hold a track key: the Mod Menu opens. Pick DIGISWARM and press YES.
Play into the inputs; NO turns it off and gives the synths back.

controls.name: Mod Menu (hold a track key)
controls.doc: Open DigiSwarm: it takes the audio engine and its page shows. Its Mod Menu entry also brings the page back after MIDI.

controls.name: SYN1, SYN2, FLTR
controls.doc: Its three pages: page 1 Effect (ACT, REP, SHP, FLT, MIX, TIME, SPC, LOOP), page 2 Shift (input gain, pitch modulation, resonance, effect volume, loop speed, room, fade), page 3 Looper. Pushing a knob sets it back to its default.

controls.name: AMP
controls.doc: The mixer: the inputs' levels and pans, balance, volume and width.

controls.name: LFO
controls.doc: Two LFOs on the stock LFO page; DEST aims them at its controls or the mixer.

controls.name: RECORD
controls.doc: LOCK mode: hold a trig and turn a control to lock it on that step; FUNC + a trig clears the step.

controls.name: MIDI
controls.doc: The stock UI for the MIDI tracks while it keeps playing.

controls.name: NO
controls.doc: Turn it off: the synths and the Digitone's own effects come back.

controls.name: Trig 1-11, 13-16
controls.doc: Pick the engine (1-11) and its variation A-D (13-16).

limitations: While it is the active effect it owns the audio engine: the synths are silent and the Digitone's own effects are off. NO gives them back; the sequencer keeps running.

Its MIDI CCs follow the Hologram Electronics Microcosm's published CC chart, so a controller set up for that pedal works with it. It is not affiliated with Hologram Electronics and uses none of its code.
A beta from its author; not yet run on a Digitone Keys.
Its buffers use 27 MB of the Digitone's bulk memory (0x44000000-0x45B00000), apart from the other effect pedals'.
Needs fxkit (it comes with it) and core 4.1 or newer, so on OS 1.44 it does not build beside KitBank 0.2.0, which builds only on the older core.

load.display: Runs in the audio render while it is the active effect, nothing while it is off
load.conditions: From the source: its render handlers process the inputs only while it owns the audio (fxkit's core_audio owner); its other handlers run on the UI side. The author's CPU readings are from the emulator only. Not measured on a unit in Modwerk.

hardware.summary: The author tested DigiSwarm 0.2 on a Digitone mk1 (release v0.2, 18 October 2026; built before the effects' rename, which changed only names) and checked it in digikit's emulator on OS 1.43 and 1.44. It is still a beta. This module pins the released files.
limitations: The author's report names no OS release, date or duration: testedOn is the v0.2 release date, and 1.44 is the newest OS its files support.
Not run on a Digitone Keys.
Not tested in Modwerk on a unit.

tests.summary: The author's released 0.2 files, pinned unchanged, linked locally with core 5.4 and Modwerk's fxkit 0.1.0: alone, beside each of the other five effect pedals, all six together, and beside DigiHealth and DigiTables on OS 1.43; on OS 1.44 every pair but KitBank (core 2.x only). Emulator captures show where it appears; nothing ran on a unit in Modwerk.

license.declaration: The author's source, imported unchanged from github.com/irpina/digiswarm at a5a2f55 (v0.2) under its GPL-2.0-or-later licence. Modwerk adds elekloader's SDK headers digitone-mk1/core3.h and digitone-mk1/fxkit.h from tag fxkit-v0.1 (irpina, GPL-2.0-or-later), which the source includes. The library builds the author's released digiswarm-0.2 .elemod files.
